text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Sprinters Stakes, a race to crown the 
fastest sprinter. All eyes are on Biko 
Pegasus and Hishi Akebono, two Umamusume 
with a massive difference in physique.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Biko Pegasus in full hero mode and 
Hishi Akebono enthusiastically playing the 
villain, the paddock was buzzing with 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus is overwhelmed with emotion 
now that her best friend has reached the 
same stage. And so, their serious showdown 
is finally about to begin!
